method: seeded deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle of pre-matched pair IDs, then deterministic provider-order shuffle within every pair
allocation: 1600 matched pairs; each pair has exactly one Treatment and one Control; every pair is queried once against SearXNG and once against Marginalia
provider_balance: exactly 800 pairs start with SearXNG and 800 with Marginalia; identical provider order schedule for Treatment and Control within each pair
analysis_strata: provider is a prespecified blocking/stratification variable, never an arm-specific route
reproducibility: sort by pair_id before hashing; no runtime entropy; record seed and manifest hash
